checks.Simpson: One fixed noise condition; methods kept separate; no pooling across different conditions.
checks.Ecological: Inference concerns seed-level simulated groups, not individual animal biology or independent edges.
checks.Berkson: All64 prespecified seeds retained; conclusions restricted to the pilot-selected condition.
checks.Collider: No adjustment or exclusion using post-treatment GO, RMSE, geometry or cohesion.
checks.BaseRate: No diagnostic-classification or universal success-probability claim.
checks.RegressionToMean: Earlier6 seeds selected the promising condition; independent new seeds alone determine formal inference; do not merge old data.
checks.Survivorship: Require all256 trajectories and64 four-arm markers, with all failures retained.
checks.LookElsewhere: Report all six contrasts, Holm6 p and Bonferroni simultaneous intervals; secondary metrics descriptive.
checks.ForkingPaths: Sample size, seeds, parameters, endpoints, contrasts and margins frozen before new outcomes; no effect-based stopping.
checks.CorrelationCausation: Paired intervention estimates a total policy effect in this model; does not identify error mediation or neural-denoising mechanism.
checks.ReverseCausality: Closed-loop trajectories affect subsequent bearings and errors; lower own-trajectory RMSE is not assumed to cause higher GO.

uncertainty: Paired t intervals assume suitable seed-level mean behavior; paired bootstrap is sensitivity analysis, not a guarantee. Practical margin0.05 is operational, not biological.
